verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing documents built-in automation rules, created with Rovo AI rather than code (reminders, rules that move work forward), plus automation that connects tools to Jira workflows. That supports codeless automation, but the pack never describes a no-code rule builder, multi-step chaining (triggers, conditions, sequential actions), or any hands-on use. Missing for 10: explicit no-code builder documentation, evidence of multi-step/branching rule composition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
Scale processes and save time with customizable workflows that integrate with your tech stack.
